title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-07-01
lineage: R1 > Technics RS-1506 > TEAC AN-300 [Dolby Decode] > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > WAV [24/96]
source: Sony ECM-22P > Sony TC-770 > MAR > ?? [Dolby Encode] > R1

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a fiery 1973 show where Jerry’s guitar blazes, though occasional pitch quirks are noted.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crisp, present mix that almost feels like a matrix source, delivering the full concert with excellent instrument separation. Musically the night shines thanks to Jerry Garcia’s “liquid fire” playing and a solid second‑set jam, making it a must‑listen despite a few vocal fade‑aways and disputed pitch issues.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and highlight strong performance and good sound, but a couple of low ratings focus on pitch problems, creating some uncertainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp with presence, snap and sparkle; occasional vocal fade‑aways and slurs. Pitch is debated – some claim it’s perfect, others find it unlistenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong overall flow with a particularly praised second‑set jam; Jerry’s guitar work drives the energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as ‘liquid fire’, tearing it up, perfect tone and high energy.
